name: Grok
author: Timon Röhrbacher (based on grokbar-omarchy by pixbroker)
description: SuperGrok usage on the bar, plus optional Cursor, Grok Bot, and GPT.

barWidget.description: Bar widget for SuperGrok usage, plus optional Cursor, Grok Bot, and GPT.

schema.label: Icon only
schema.description: Show only the Grok Bot logo on the bar, no usage numbers (local patch). The panel is unchanged.

schema.label: Glance looks (trial)
schema.description: Comma list of Grok Bot weekly-usage looks right of the icon (icon-only mode): 1 ring+dots, 2 ring+days, 3 two bars, 4 pace-coloured ring; hugging, all pace-coloured: 5 thin ring touching the disc, 6 ring on the disc edge, 7 logo scaled into look 4's ring, 8 logo disc as the gauge, 9 thick ring touching. Empty = off.

schema.label: Show Cursor usage
schema.description: Show Cursor monthly pools on the bar. Off by default; also toggled from panel settings.

schema.label: Show Grok Bot usage
schema.description: Show Grok Bot weekly pool on the bar. Off by default; also toggled from panel settings.

schema.label: Show GPT usage
schema.description: Show GPT usage from the local Codex session. Off by default; also toggled from panel settings.
